text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A, E, and B for gains did not protect me from later market movements; I should avoid treating a realized profit as proof that selling was the right choice.","I bought more A and B at higher prices after selling earlier shares, which shows that gain-focused trading can lead me to sell low relative to where I later re-enter; I should assess each decision on its merits.","My account value fluctuated despite making few trades, so I should not let short-term changes pressure me into action; I will review my holdings periodically against a clear plan."]}
